# akeyless_gateway_ldap_auth_config (Resource)

LDAP auth config for gateway



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_id` (String) The access ID of the auth method associated with the LDAP config
- `bind_dn` (String) Bind DN
- `bind_dn_password` (String, Sensitive) Bind DN password
- `group_attr` (String) LDAP attribute to follow on objects returned by ldap_group_filter in order to enumerate user group membership
- `group_dn` (String) Base DN to perform group membership search
- `group_filter` (String) Go template used when constructing the group membership query. The template can access the following context variables: [UserDN, Username]
- `ldap_ca_cert` (String) LDAP CA Certificate (base64 encoded)
- `ldap_enable` (String) Enable LDAP auth [true/false]
- `ldap_url` (String) LDAP server URL
- `retry` (Block List, Max: 1) Retry this resource's operations when the error matches error_message_regex. Overrides the provider retry block. See the Customized Retry guide. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--retry))
- `signing_key_data` (String, Sensitive) The private key (base64 encoded), associated with the public key defined in the Ldap auth
- `user_attribute` (String) LDAP user attribute
- `user_dn` (String) LDAP user DN

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--retry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry`

Optional:

- `error_message_regex` (List of String) Regular expressions matched against the error message. If any matches, the operation is retried.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Wait before the first retry, in seconds. The wait doubles on each retry.
- `max_interval_seconds` (Number) Maximum wait between retries, in seconds.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries after the first attempt.
- `retry_on_status_codes` (List of Number) HTTP status codes of the failed API call that trigger a retry, for example 429 or 503.
